2025-05-01 - Set up GitHub repository named Service-Desk-History.

2025-05-01 - Created start_react.sh script to automate deployment and app start process.
2025-05-01 - Built a macOS Automator shortcut to run start_react.sh for quick access.
2025-05-01 - Encountered JSON cache issues that prevented updates from appearing in the app.
2025-05-01 - Fixed cache issues by updating the JSON location and using ?v= parameter cache-busting in the React app.
2025-05-01 - Added GitHub Actions workflow for advanced cache clearing (later removed for simplicity).
2025-05-01 - Established process to export updated JSON from ChatGPT, overwrite the local file, and deploy using the shortcut.
2025-05-01 - Verified that deploying updates automatically pushes new records to the live app.

Summary:
- All app data lives in public/react_dictionary_export.json.
- Editing the JSON and running the shortcut will deploy changes and restart the app.
- GitHub Pages hosts the live version of the app.
- npm start = runs local app.
- npm run deploy = publishes changes to live site.
- start_react.sh automates both.
- Automator shortcut triggers start_react.sh for easy use.

Advanced Tip:
- Cache issues can be avoided by adding '?v=' + new version number to the JSON URL in App.js.
- Always commit and push changes to GitHub before deploying.
- Troubleshooting tools: Terminal (for git, npm), browser DevTools (for cache clearing and inspecting live JSON).
